name: Supplier Master Sync
purpose: Loads every supplier into the new procurement system as one clean record per supplier

inputs.supplier_id: ID the old systems used for the supplier
inputs.supplier_name: Registered name of the supplier company
inputs.contact_person: Full name of the person to contact at the supplier
inputs.email: Email address to send orders and invoices to
inputs.city: City or town the supplier is based in
inputs.country: Country the supplier is based in
inputs.postal_code: Postal code of the supplier's address
inputs.payment_terms: How many days the company has to pay the supplier's invoices
inputs.supplier_category: Kind of goods or services the supplier provides
inputs.onboarding_date: Date the supplier was first set up
inputs.is_active: Whether the company can still buy from the supplier
inputs.source_system: Name of the system the supplier record was exported from
